contexts.text: He is not under his own jurisdiction, but under that of (evil Spirits).
That they will not be under their own jurisdiction, Signified.
In this is founded the law of the first-born.
The right of a king. AE 638:22.
The law of retaliation. Quoted and Explained.
To sue at the law () = an endeavour to destroy.
To sue at the law, and to want to take away the coat = to debate about truths, and to want to persuade that it is not truth.
To desist from evils is left to man's own jurisdiction.
If a man is in evil from the time when he has come to his own rationality and freedom, that is, to his own jurisdiction...
a. On the law of nature. DMin 4640.
There are many useful sciences... such as... the civil law.
To sue at the law, and take away the coat = to take away interior truth.
That the truths of the Word and its goods will then be turned into falsities and evils, is signified by he will change times and law ().
